data.standardized_narrative: Prior year reserves (notably 2012 and earlier) developed favourably in 2014, resulting in an aggregate release of GBP 12.9m. The release reflects favourable prior-year claims development across the Syndicate's main classes (Property and Aviation) and contributed to the 2014 profitability. The Syndicate recorded modest catastrophe activity in 2014 (Hurricanes Odile and Gonzalo) which fell within budget, while legacy 2012 catastrophes (Superstorm Sandy, Hurricane Isaac, US tornados) and aviation large losses influenced the prior years' reserving experience.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure used is a narrative-stated release of GBP 12.9m (assumed gross) from the Managing Agent's report. A large 'Change in provision for gross claims' table elsewhere shows different gross movements by year which appear to be presented in a different aggregation/context; no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note with a clear Insurance liabilities column was found for 2014 other than the narrative. Some event losses and reserve figures are reported in USD in the report and have not been converted. No gross claims development triangle was located; calculation of PYD therefore relies on narrative.
